method: Deep-research replay derived from the already-frozen 2022Q2 event set. Company evidence and deterministic pre-cutoff price-regime snapshots are cutoff-bounded; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No post-cutoff selected-stock returns are opened before deep memos lock.
Pre-cutoff regime snapshots use only bars on or before each memo cutoff.
Use as holdout process evidence, not clean forward alpha.
